channel.title: KS Fiks documentation :: KS Fiks
channel.description: This site documents the Fiks platform. Most of the documentation is in Norwegian. Only some services have an English version. The documentation is for those who administer the platform on behalf of a municipality or other organization, or who develop integrations against the APIs Fiks offers. Available in English KS Besøksbidrag (visitor levy) – the Register API, and reporting for accommodation providers (coming) Errors If you find errors or something that is not described well enough, please send an email to fiks@ksdigital.no.

item.title: KS Besøksbidrag
item.description: Short description Reporting of visitor levy (besøksbidrag) for accommodation providers and intermediaries. KS Besøksbidrag is a national service that helps Norwegian municipalities administer the visitor levy introduced through the Besøksbidragsloven. This page is for accommodation providers, booking platforms and other intermediaries, and for vendors building systems for them. It explains how to find out which municipalities and periods have a visitor levy, and how to report turnover.
